name: Big Chicken
hint: Keep heading north along the boulevard for a crispy reward.
description:
Big Chicken is a fast-food restaurant on Bulevardul Revoluției, in the central Podgoria area of Arad. Its specialty is crispy fried chicken, served on the spot or delivered to your door, and it is a quick stop for a snack or a full meal.

The company behind it, Big Chicken S.R.L., was registered in 2015 and reported 35 employees in 2025, making it one of the larger restaurant businesses in the city. It has no connection to the US chain of the same name.

At the time this database was compiled (2026), the restaurant listed opening hours of 10:00 to 23:00 every day. Hours can change, so check before a special trip.
